name: Tourism Sustainable Mobility & Accessibility Index v1
scope: Municipal screening index based only on available, validated project artifacts. It is not a causal model or an accessibility certification.

components.coverage_score: Accommodation coverage to GTFS stops within 800m
components.gap_score: Inverse share of accommodation gaps over 1200m
components.proximity_score: Inverse normalized municipal median distance to nearest GTFS stop
components.routing_score: OTP route success in exploratory screening
components.transit_score: Transit availability in exploratory OTP screening

universal_access_proxy.note: The GTFS wheelchair_boarding tag is retained as a separate proxy and is not included in TSMAI v1 without sufficient documented coverage.

limitations: No cycling infrastructure, slope, perceived safety, reviews, air quality or traffic are included.
The OTP screening is nearest eligible POI based, not observed demand.
Weights are transparent analytical choices and should be sensitivity-tested before policy use.
